shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**' -g 'README*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 4 'markdown|editor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Button Text Select Label Switch Modal && rg -n 'base-(background|float|generic|info)|spacing|border-radius' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Button Text Select Label Switch Modal && rg -n 'base-(background|float|generic|info)|spacing|border-radius' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -45"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | rg '/(TextInput|Button|Select|Label|Switch|Modal|Text)/.*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0 peerDependencies && sed -n '90,125p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && sed -n '180,200p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files src && cat vite.config.ts index.html && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | rg '(INDEX.md|MarkdownEditorView.d.ts|useMarkdownEditor.d.ts|MarkdownEditor.d.ts|Renderer.*d.ts|settings.*d.ts)"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts && rg -n 'preview|renderPreview|split|initial' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md && sed -n '1,210p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'transform\\(|html:|sanitize|css' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.css | head -90"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/types.d.ts && sed -n '30,90p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md && cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts && rg -n -- '--g-md|--g-md-editor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles/*.css | head -50 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.js | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '30,90p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md && head -65 node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts && rg -n -- '--g-md' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles | head -40 && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.js && rg -n -C 2 'replace|setValue|clear' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/*.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist && head -65 node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/toolbar/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-customize-toolbars.md | head -130 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkupEditorView.css | head -90'

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist/js && rg -n 'browser|Browser|client|bundle' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/*.d.ts node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/markdown-it/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/constants.d.ts | head -90"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/markdown-it | head -30 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/index.d.ts && rg -n 'transform|markdown-it' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/markup/*.js | head -30 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/index.d.ts && head -90 node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '80,145p' node_modules/markdown-it/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -70 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/constants.d.ts | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install markdown-it@13 @diplodoc/transform@4.78.12 && npm install -D @types/markdown-it@13'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && npx vitest run'

/bin/bash -lc "npm ls punycode && rg -n 'punycode' node_modules/markdown-it/lib/index.js && rg -n -- '--g-color-line-generic-accent:|--g-color-base-generic-ultralight:|--g-color-sfx-shadow:|--g-font-family-monospace:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -15 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.js | head -95"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'punycode' node_modules/markdown-it/lib/index.js && sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js && rg -n -- '--g-color-line-generic-accent:|--g-color-base-generic-ultralight:|--g-color-sfx-shadow:|--g-font-family-monospace:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -15 && head -85 node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.js && rg -n 'process|cwd|env' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install punycode@2.3.1 && npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/App.css src/markdown.ts src/markdown.test.ts src/main.tsx vite.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && npx vitest run'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && cat package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore'
